The speaker is preoccupied with the idea of being misunderstood by others regarding their personal struggles.
observations.quote: People saw what was in front of them. Didn't look any further because why would they? And so what they probably saw when they looked in front of them was somebody in a lot of pain.

observations.text: The speaker claims to have been triumphantly returning from something but acknowledges others saw only pain.
observations.quote: I felt that I was triumphantly returning from something, and I was. But I was triumphantly returning from something nobody knew anything about.
